verdict.rationale: Compliance and trust are a fair axis for LiveKit Agents, since it offers a hosted LiveKit Cloud deployment. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions HIPAA, a BAA, SOC 2 attestation, or explicit data-residency or region-pinning options. Self-hosting is documented and verified hands-on, but it is never presented as a compliance or residency offering, and "global infrastructure" does not imply regional data controls, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.
